summary: Full final production implementation plan for category-dedicated staff workspaces powered by Atrium's unified UI/UX design system (AtriumButton, #F8F9FA pod trays, #1F1D1B Dark Espresso anchors, UniversalDataCollection, kinetic Seek, LabelInput/LabelSelect) and full trilingual parity across French, Modern Standard Arabic (RTL with Cairo), and English. Eliminates all screen duplication (Agency Project RH, Gym Finance) while giving every category a dedicated workforce view tailored to its domain operations.
